notes: Second well block on the page (table 3 counting the column-heading block as table 1). Heading: 5/2W-32A1 (City of Vallejo, well 8). Hale Fruit Company. About 3.2 miles west of Fairfield, 0.26 mile westerly along paved private road from road junction, 500 feet northerly normal to private road, in frame pump house in southwest corner of large clearing. Irrigation well. Measurements through 1939 by City of Vallejo. 'City of Vallejo, well 8' is the report's/owner's other well name. Some values carry footnote mark 3 (footnotes on another page). No county, state or year drilled printed.
